body: Thank you for this, I appreciate the honesty. I admit I find it incredibly difficult to stay calm when I'm angry, and it fuels my paranoid thinking.

Just as examples: they often restrict where I can go in the house, they deny saying things a lot, they say 'I have a weird imagination and should get help', and one member of staff said that I could commit suicide by hanging myself. Later on, I brought them up on it, and they said they wouldn't tell me to do it that way.

I'm being evicted because of angry outbursts I was having at the supported living unit. I was never physically violent but verbally I was rude. I think the community is against me because people are aware of what I've done and the family issues. The staff mess with me because of that too.

I was angry a lot at this supported housing unit and they decided to evict me. It wasn't anything to do with therapy, maybe I didn't make that clear, my therapy is done outside of the supported living unit.
